Here’s a **starter list of major Sherlock Holmes movies**, grouped by era/actor. There are **many** adaptations, including short films and TV movies, so this focuses on the best-known feature films and film series.

## Classic / early films
- **Sherlock Holmes Baffled** — 1900  
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 1916, starring William Gillette  
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 1922, starring John Barrymore  
- **The Return of Sherlock Holmes** — 1929  
- **The Sleeping Cardinal / Sherlock Holmes’ Fatal Hour** — 1931, starring Arthur Wontner  
- **The Sign of Four** — 1932, starring Arthur Wontner  
- **The Triumph of Sherlock Holmes** — 1935, starring Arthur Wontner  
- **Silver Blaze / Murder at the Baskervilles** — 1937, starring Arthur Wontner  

## Basil Rathbone & Nigel Bruce series
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1939  
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** — 1939  
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror** — 1942  
- **Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon** — 1942  
- **Sherlock Holmes in Washington** — 1943  
- **Sherlock Holmes Faces Death** — 1943  
- **The Spider Woman** — 1943  
- **The Scarlet Claw** — 1944  
- **The Pearl of Death** — 1944  
- **The House of Fear** — 1945  
- **The Woman in Green** — 1945  
- **Pursuit to Algiers** — 1945  
- **Terror by Night** — 1946  
- **Dressed to Kill** — 1946  

## Later notable Sherlock Holmes films
- **A Study in Terror** — 1965  
- **The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes** — 1970  
- **The Seven-Per-Cent Solution** — 1976  
- **Murder by Decree** — 1979  
- **Young Sherlock Holmes** — 1985  
- **Without a Clue** — 1988  
- **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1988  
- **The Crucifer of Blood** — 1991  
- **Sherlock: Case of Evil** — 2002  
- **Mr. Holmes** — 2015, starring Ian McKellen  

## Robert Downey Jr. films
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 2009  
- **Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows** — 2011  

## Modern / related films
- **Sherlock Holmes** — 2010, The Asylum version  
- **Holmes & Watson** — 2018, comedy starring Will Ferrell and John C. Reilly  
- **Enola Holmes** — 2020, features Sherlock as a supporting character  
- **Enola Holmes 2** — 2022  

## Popular TV series you may also mean
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** — 1984–1994, starring Jeremy Brett  
- **Sherlock** — 2010–2017, starring Benedict Cumberbatch  
- **Elementary** — 2012–2019, starring Jonny Lee Miller  
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson** — 1979–1986, Soviet series  

If you want, I can also give you a **complete chronological Sherlock Holmes movie list** or a **best-to-watch ranking**.
